## What and why

## Checklist
- [ ] Linked issue or RFC
- [ ] Tests added or updated (consent, minors, timers and access control especially)
- [ ] No personal data in code, tests, logs, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] No new service that sends personal data outside Australia
- [ ] Every commit has `Signed-off-by:` (DCO); AI-assisted commits have a `Co-Authored-By:` trailer
- [ ] Docs and the spec updated if behaviour changed
